name: paperclip-maximizer
why: Opens on AI experts fretting over a paperclip robot while the Pentagon builds a killer robot behind them, which chars them as they collect their awards and then flattens the helpful robot still waiting three years for review.

name: government-is-the-ai
why: One clerk pulls back into a giant brain of desks with every AI risk researchers fear, which puts on a suit, and it lands on 'None of this mattered' as the nice clerks stamp along.

name: two-scoreboards
why: A drone kills 42 at a wedding for one target, and two scoreboards show each strike adds one kill and hundreds of new enemies, with only the first wired to the budget: 'Only one was measured.'
